tasks.description: Create a registration endpoint that accepts an email address and a password. The endpoint should validate that the email is well-formed and the password meets a minimum length of 8 characters. It should also reject registration when the email is already in use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when the registration endpoint is called, then a new user account is created.
Given an invalid email, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error is returned.
Given a password with less than 8 characters, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error is returned.
Given an email that is already in use, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error is returned.

tasks.description: Store passwords using bcrypt hashing. Never store or log plaintext passwords. This task should be completed in conjunction with the registration endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user account, when the password is stored, then it is hashed using bcrypt.
Given a plaintext password, when it is logged, then it is not stored in the logs.

tasks.description: Create a login endpoint that accepts an email and password, verifies the password against the stored bcrypt hash, and rejects invalid credentials with a generic error message.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then a successful login response is returned.
Given invalid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then a generic error message is returned.

tasks.description: On successful login, issue a signed JWT access token that encodes the user identity and an expiry. The frontend attaches this token to subsequent authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when a JWT token is issued, then it contains the user identity and an expiry.
Given a JWT token, when it is attached to an authenticated request, then the request is authenticated successfully.

tasks.description: Create a logout endpoint that ends the user's session so the token can no longer be used for authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid JWT token, when the logout endpoint is called, then the token is invalidated.
Given an invalidated token, when it is attached to an authenticated request, then the request is not authenticated.

tasks.description: Write unit tests to cover the authentication endpoints and ensure they are working as expected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.
Given a test case, when it is executed, then it covers a specific authentication scenario.

tasks.description: Write integration tests to cover the authentication endpoints and ensure they are working as expected in a real-world scenario.
acceptance_criteria: Given an integration test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.
Given an integration test case, when it is executed, then it covers a specific authentication scenario.
